CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   B. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.

   D. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. Best practice when working on Middle Distance Races and Montage: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Drawing and Painting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
